caption: The drawing features a full-length depiction of a woman standing and facing forward, dressed in a long, dark green Victorian-style dress with a fitted bodice and a flared skirt that reaches the floor. The dress has black buttons down the center front and is accented with white lace at the collar and cuffs. She is wearing brown gloves and brown shoes with red bows. On her head, she wears a hat composed of a beige and green woven or wrapped fabric, which is topped with a white netting or lace. The background of the image is a light beige with no additional objects or scenery. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch in gray lines showing the same woman in profile, displaying the side view of her outfit and hat. The composition centers the woman and her outfit prominently, with the added sketch providing an alternate perspective.
title: Doll
